mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(pw.point_balance, 0) AS currentPoint FROM user_tbl AS user LEFT OUTER JOIN point_wallet_tbl AS pw ON user.user_id = pw.user_id WHERE user.user_id = #{userId} AND user.user_status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1

SELECT IFNULL(ecu.current_level, 1) AS userChallengeLevel , IFNULL(ecu.current_target, 0) AS userChallengeExe , CASE WHEN ecu.challenge_id IS NULL THEN 1000 ELSE ec.max_target END AS userChallengeMaxExe , DATE_FORMAT(ec.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS challengeStartAt , DATE_FORMAT(ec.end_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS challengeEndAt FROM event_challenge_tbl AS ec LEFT OUTER JOIN event_challenge_user_tbl AS ecu ON ec.challenge_id = ecu.challenge_id AND ecu.user_id = #{userId} # WHERE NOW() BETWEEN ec.start_date AND ec.end_date ORDER BY ecu.current_level DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT e.event_id AS eventId , e.event_name AS eventName , e.event_desc AS eventDesc , e.event_type AS eventType , e.event_img_name AS eventImgName , e.end_at AS endAt , IFNULL(e.event_daily_limit_count,0) AS dailyLimitCount , IFNULL(e.event_target, 0) AS eventTarget , IFNULL(er.event_level, 1) AS currentLevel , IFNULL(er.req_count, 0) AS reqCount , IFNULL(er.reward_point, 0) AS rewardPoint , IFNULL(ep_sub.partcount, 0) AS partCount , CASE -- 0. [출석] 오늘 아직 출첵 안함 WHEN e.event_type = 'ATTENDANCE' AND IFNULL(today_att.today_chk, 0) = 0 THEN 'ATTENDANCE_READY' -- 1. [출석완료] 출석 완료 + 보상 수령 WHEN e.event_type = 'ATTENDANCE' AND IFNULL(today_att.today_chk, 0) > 0 THEN 'ATTENDANCE_COMPLETE' -- 2. [수령완료] 보상 수령 완료 WHEN e.event_type != 'ATTENDANCE' AND err.recv_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'COMPLETE' -- 3. [보상받기] 목표 달성은 했으나 리워드 수령 안한 상태 WHEN e.event_type != 'ATTENDANCE' AND IFNULL(ep_sub.partcount, 0) >= er.req_count AND err.recv_id IS NULL THEN 'REWARD_CLAIM' -- 4. [참여완료] 이벤트 참여 완료한 상태, 레벨 목표치 미달성인 경우 WHEN e.event_type != 'ATTENDANCE' AND IFNULL(ep_sub.partcount, 0) > 0 AND err.recv_id IS NULL THEN 'PROGRESS' -- 5. [참여] 참여 내역 없는 최초 상태 ELSE 'READY' END AS buttonStatus FROM event_tbl AS e -- 이벤트 참여횟수 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT event_id, COUNT(*) AS partcount FROM (SELECT event_id, user_id FROM event_participation_tbl UNION ALL SELECT event_id, user_id FROM event_attendance_tbl ) AS total_part WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY event_id ) AS ep_sub ON e.event_id = ep_sub.event_id
-- 현재 이벤트 진행 정보 LEFT JOIN event_reward_tbl AS er ON e.event_id = er.event_id AND er.use_yn = 'Y' AND er.event_level = (SELECT IFNULL(MIN(inner_er.event_level), (SELECT MAX(max_er.event_level) FROM event_reward_tbl max_er WHERE max_er.event_id = e.event_id AND max_er.use_yn = 'Y')) FROM event_reward_tbl inner_er LEFT JOIN event_reward_receive_tbl inner_err ON inner_er.reward_id = inner_err.reward_id AND inner_err.user_id = #{userId} WHERE inner_er.event_id = e.event_id AND inner_er.use_yn = 'Y' AND inner_err.recv_id IS NULL )
-- 매일 출석체크 오늘자 참여 가능 여부 LEFT JOIN (SELECT event_id, COUNT(*) AS today_chk FROM event_attendance_tbl WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(participated_at) = CURDATE() GROUP BY event_id ) AS today_att ON e.event_id = today_att.event_id
-- 리워드 수령이력 LEFT JOIN event_reward_receive_tbl AS err ON er.reward_id = err.reward_id AND err.user_id = #{userId} AND ((e.event_type = 'ATTENDANCE' AND DATE(err.received_at) = CURDATE()) OR (e.event_type != 'ATTENDANCE')) WHERE e.event_status = 'OPEN' AND (NOW() BETWEEN e.start_at AND e.end_at OR e.end_at IS NULL) # AND (e.event_type = 'ATTENDANCE' OR err.recv_id IS NULL) GROUP BY e.event_id , e.event_name , e.event_desc , e.event_type , e.event_img_name , e.end_at , er.event_level , er.req_count , er.reward_point , ep_sub.partcount , err.recv_id ORDER BY e.event_id ASC

SELECT e.event_id AS eventId , e.event_name AS eventName , e.event_desc AS eventDesc , e.event_type AS eventType , e.event_img_name AS eventImgName , DATE_FORMAT(err.received_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS endAt , IFNULL(er.reward_point,0) AS rewardPoint , 'COMPLETE' AS buttonStatus , err.received_at AS receivedAt FROM event_reward_receive_tbl AS err INNER JOIN event_tbl AS e ON err.event_id = e.event_id LEFT OUTER JOIN event_reward_tbl AS er ON err.event_id = er.event_id AND err.reward_id = er.reward_id WHERE err.user_id = #{userId} AND DATE_FORMAT(err.received_at, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} ORDER BY err.received_at DESC
